name: Multisite Conformance and Replication Readiness
objective: Determine whether the controlled-pilot control system can be replicated across additional admitted sites without weakening evidence, governance, DMRV, QMS, custody, anchor, or claim boundaries.
replication_unit: An independently identified and authorized site; administrative/reporting nodes are not physical installations unless separately admitted.
required_artifacts: QMS pathway and results when empirical pilot evidence exists
fail_closed_conditions: evidence schema drift without approved migration
cross-site values presented as interchangeable without evidence
invariants: Global Lagos remains the reference/proof pilot.
International grids inherit evidence semantics, not evidence values.
Administrative/reporting nodes do not become physical harvest claims by enumeration.
Brazil remains anchor-pending unless independently evidenced.
Forecasts/models/proxies cannot be promoted to observed evidence.
Blockchain anchors establish integrity/traceability, not environmental truth.
Software replication readiness does not equal physical product release.
